lines.t: First election, You have called us by name
“Which of you will seek My fullness,
Which of you will dare to believe?”
Hidden manna in the hands of the weak
You say, “Come to Me, My children,
Ask of Me in earnest expectation, and receive.”Leper standing on the edge of the crowd
Crying, “If You’re willing, Lord, You can make me clean.”
You reached out, laid Your hand on his shame
In a moment, every stain disappeared like a dream
You whispered, “Go your way,” not back to the priests
But deeper into the heart of the unseen
So here we are, trembling, but we rise again
Dust on our knees, yet You call us Your friends
Every faltering step, You still commend
Faith like fire in the wind
I will reach for the hem of Your garment
I will cry out Your name in the storm
I will fall at Your feet in surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For You said, “Come, believing, and receive it all”
You said, “Come, believing, and you will be made whole”
When You look in my eyes, let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
Ten were cleansed as they walked in Your word
“Go, show yourselves to the priests,” and as they went, they were healed
But one turned back with a shout and a song
Fell down, giving glory, every wound revealed
A stranger, a foreigner, a Samaritan heart
Found the door into the mystery You sealedRoman soldier with a servant in pain
Said, “Just speak the word and it shall be done.”
You marveled at a faith that broke every wall
A gentile heart that trusted the Holy One
You said, “Not even Israel has such faith as this,”
And the healing came at once
So teach my soul to trust beyond my sight
To cling to You when shadows steal the light
To run back to Your feet and hold on tight
Till Your joy breaks through the night
I will reach for the hem of Your garment
I will cry out Your name in the storm
I will fall at Your feet in surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For You said, “Come, believing, and receive it all”
You said, “Come, believing, and you will be made whole”
When You look in my eyes, let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
Oh, keep me from the crowd that only touches but never believes
From the dog that returns to the mire, from the heart that retreats
Let me be the one who turns around, to fall at Your feet
To give You glory with my every breath, in sorrow and in peaceWhen the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on the earth?
Let it be in my voice, let it burn in my words
Let it sing in my weakness, let it shout in my tears
Childlike trust through the trembling yearsSo I cast down my fear, my religion, my pride
I step out of the line just to walk by Your side
You say, “Come near, My beloved, come abide”
And I believe, I believe
I will reach for the hem of Your garment
I will cry out Your name in the storm
I will cry out Your name in the storm
I will fall at Your feet in surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For You said, “Come, believing, and receive it all”
You said, “Come, believing, and you will be made whole”
When You look in my eyes, let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
Earnest expectation, I lift my eyes
Hidden manna falling from the sky
You reward all who diligently seek Your face
Find in me, Lord, a holy faith
Find in me, Lord, a holy faith
